info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Application Status API provides real-time updates on the status of job applications within the organization's recruitment process. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their submitted applications, including details such as application received, under review, and interview scheduled. It is typically utilized by job seekers who want to track their application progress effectively. API consumers can leverage this functionality to enhance the transparency of the recruitment journey and stay informed of their application status.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of applications in the system, providing insights into their operational state and any relevant metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of applications. This includes any necessary parameters to filter or modify the output of the application status check.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of applications.
